summary: Information Technology Director with 16 years of experience leading IT operations for a large law firm, managing staff, implementing and upgrading core systems, ensuring data security and compliance, and driving cost‑effective vendor negotiations.

experience.title: Information Technology Director
responsibilities: Led IT operations for the largest law firm in Central Pennsylvania, supporting 275 office users across six locations and 200 remote users.
Managed a team of seven IT professionals and participated in multiple project implementation teams.
Oversaw maintenance and implementation of voice and data communications, ensuring security, stability, and budget compliance.
Negotiated vendor contracts to secure competitive pricing for circuits and services.
Planned and executed upgrades of core systems, including time and billing, Microsoft Office suites, GroupWise, Worldox, and Audix voice messaging.
Implemented VOIP systems, mobile applications, and secure remote access solutions (VPN, RDP).
Developed and maintained data security policies, HIPAA compliance, vulnerability audits, and disaster recovery plans.
Served as Security Officer, establishing technical security systems and procedures.
Managed full project lifecycles from requirements gathering to deployment and user training.

projects.name: VOIP Implementation
projects.description: Deployed VOIP systems at two regional offices to improve voice communication efficiency.

projects.name: Mobile Application Deployment
projects.description: Implemented mobile apps for attorneys, including VPN, RDP, dictation, Dropbox, and Office Mobile Suite.

projects.name: Core System Upgrades
projects.description: Upgraded time and billing, Microsoft Office, GroupWise, Worldox, and Audix voice messaging systems.

projects.name: CRM Implementation
projects.description: Assisted Marketing in implementing a firm‑wide Customer Relationship Management system.

projects.name: Disaster Recovery Plan
projects.description: Authored and maintained the firm's business/continuity/disaster recovery plan for IT applications and systems.
